exam.name: GATE 2027 — Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (DA)
exam.organizingInstitute: IIT Madras (confirmed: official GATE 2027 site states 'Organizing Institute: Indian Institute of Technology Madras'). Previous DA papers: 2024 IISc Bangalore, 2025 IIT Roorkee, 2026 IIT Guwahati.
exam.expectedExamDateReason: Official GATE 2027 exam days are 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21 Feb 2027 (FN 9:30-12:30, AN 2:30-5:30); results 19 Mar 2027. The paper-wise schedule is not out yet (expected Dec 2026/Jan 2027). DA has been an afternoon paper on a weekend day: 3 Feb 2024 (Sat), 15 Feb 2025 (Sat), 15 Feb 2026 (Sun, AN). 14 Feb 2027 is a mid-window guess; plan to be exam-ready by 6 Feb 2027 and update this once IIT Madras releases the paper-wise schedule.
exam.pattern: Computer-based test, 3 hours, 65 questions, 100 marks. General Aptitude: 10 questions = 15 marks; DA subject: 55 questions = 85 marks (DA has no separate Engineering Mathematics section). Questions are 1-mark or 2-mark; types MCQ, MSQ and NAT. Negative marking only for wrong MCQs: -1/3 for a 1-mark MCQ, -2/3 for a 2-mark MCQ. No negative marking for MSQ or NAT, and no partial marking in MSQ. Virtual calculator provided. Score valid 3 years. Source: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
exam.syllabusNote: The GATE 2027 DA syllabus (checked 2026-10-03) has 7 sections: Probability & Statistics; Linear Algebra; Calculus & Optimization (single-variable only); Programming, Data Structures & Algorithms (Python); Database Management & Warehousing; Machine Learning; AI. IIT Madras says it revised several syllabi for 2027, so compare against your study material.

weightage.subject: Probability & Statistics
weightage.note: 2024: GeeksforGeeks DA 2024 analysis (10 Q). 2025: GeeksforGeeks DA 2025 analysis (12 Q). 2026: Piyush Wairale DA 2026 analysis (4x1 + 3x2). Highest-weighted subject in 2025.

weightage.subject: Linear Algebra
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (6 Q), GfG 2025 (11 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (2x1 + 3x2). Varies a lot from year to year.

weightage.subject: Calculus & Optimization
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (5 Q), GfG 2025 (5 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (3x1 + 3x2). Steady at about 8-9 marks.

weightage.subject: Programming DS & Algorithms
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (13 Q), GfG 2025 (10 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (4x1 + 6x2). Consistently one of the top two subjects; mostly Python code tracing.

weightage.subject: DBMS & Data Warehousing
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (6 Q), GfG 2025 (6 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (4x1 + 7x2). Jumped to the top subject in 2026 (B+ trees, SQL, relational algebra, normalization).

weightage.subject: Machine Learning
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (8 Q), GfG 2025 (9 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (4x1 + 6x2). Rising every year.

weightage.subject: Artificial Intelligence
weightage.note: GfG 2024 (7 Q), GfG 2025 (2 Q), Piyush Wairale 2026 (4x1 + 2x2). Unpredictable, but search and Bayes-net inference come up repeatedly.

weightage.subject: General Aptitude
weightage.note: Fixed by the exam pattern: 10 Q (5x1 + 5x2).

weightageSources: These are coaching-institute classifications, not official figures, and other analyses may split topics slightly differently. 2024: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/gate-data-science-and-ai-paper-analysis-2024/ ; 2025: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/gate-da-2025-paper-analysis/ ; 2026: https://www.piyushwairale.com/blog/gate-da-2026-question-paper-pyq-with-subject-wise-analysis-weightage ; cross-check: https://www.madeeasy.in/blog/gate-da-subject-wise-weightage . 2024 and 2025 subject marks add up to 85 + GA 15. The 2026 source's table adds up to 101 (86 + 15), so one 1-mark question is probably double-counted or misclassified: treat 2026 figures as +/-1.

goDA: GATE Overflow does not have a separate DA site; da.gateoverflow.in does not resolve. All DA questions are on the main CSE site, gateoverflow.in, filed under the usual subject categories (e.g. /artificial-intelligence, machine learning, databases) and tagged by exam. Year tags: (1) 'gate-ds-ai-2024' for the official 2024 paper (https://gateoverflow.in/tag/gate-ds-ai-2024), with questions titled 'GATE DS&AI 2024 | Question: N' (e.g. https://gateoverflow.in/422958/gate-ds&ai-2024-question-4, https://gateoverflow.in/422927/gate-ds&ai-2024-question-35); (2) 'gateda-2025' (https://gateoverflow.in/tag/gateda-2025); (3) 'gateda-2026' (https://gateoverflow.in/tag/gateda-2026), with questions titled 'GATE DA 2026 | Question: N' (e.g. https://gateoverflow.in/523166/gate-da-2026-question-48, https://gateoverflow.in/522847/gate-da-2026-question-15). Extra tags: 'gateda-sample-paper-2024' for the IISc sample paper (https://gateoverflow.in/tag/gateda-sample-paper-2024) and 'gate2024-da-memory-based' for memory-based 2024 questions posted before the official paper (https://gateoverflow.in/tag/gate2024-da-memory-based). Because the tag style changed after 2024, check both 'gate-ds-ai-YYYY' and 'gatedaYYYY'-style tags when looking for a given year; the 2027 tag will probably be 'gateda-2027'. General Aptitude questions live under https://gateoverflow.in/general-aptitude, with sub-categories verbal-aptitude, quantitative-aptitude, analytical-aptitude and spatial-aptitude. GO also publishes free compiled DA PYQ PDFs on GitHub (https://github.com/GATEOverflow/GO-PDFs/releases) and hosts the GO Classes DA test series at https://gateoverflow.in/exams (you sign in on gateoverflow.in to take the tests). Verification: gateoverflow.in sits behind a Cloudflare challenge, so these pages could not be loaded directly. Each URL was confirmed from search-engine results that index those exact pages.

strategy: Timeline (today 3 Oct 2026 to about 14 Feb 2027, ~19 weeks): Oct-Nov = finish first-pass learning; Dec = PYQs and subject tests plus first revision; Jan = full-length mocks and second revision; Feb = light revision only.

Oct 2026: finish or strengthen the maths core (Probability & Statistics, Linear Algebra, Calculus & Optimization, ~28-43 marks/yr) and PDSA in Python (16-21 marks/yr). Do 1 GA PYQ set (10 Q, 30 min) every 2-3 days throughout.

Nov 2026: Machine Learning (rising: 11 -> 14 -> 16) and DBMS & Warehousing (18 marks in 2026: B+ trees, SQL, relational algebra, normalization), then AI (search, logic, Bayes-net exact/approximate inference) by early December.
Make the 7 subjects plus GA the tracker's unit of work. Weight hours by the 3-year average marks: PDSA ~18, P&S ~15, ML ~14, DBMS ~12, LA ~12, AI ~7, Calculus ~8, GA 15.
Revise in spaced cycles: revisit each finished topic after ~1 week, ~15 days and ~1 month (GO Classes' 'every 15 days' rule). Keep a one-page formula/insight sheet and a mistake log per subject.

Use PYQs in two passes: (1) topic-wise right after finishing each topic (GATE Overflow tags gate-ds-ai-2024, gateda-2025, gateda-2026, plus related GATE CSE PYQs for DS/Algo, DBMS, Probability and LA); (2) the 3 official DA papers as timed full-length mocks in Dec-Jan, analysed line by line.
Mock cadence: 1 subject or topic test per week from Oct; 1 full-length mock per week from mid-Dec; 2-3 per week from mid-Jan to early Feb. Spend at least as long analysing each mock as taking it.
Free mocks to use: NPTEL-GATE Sunday mocks, GO Classes free AIMTs (Dec-Jan), Piyush Wairale's free DA mocks; add one paid series (GO Classes / Piyush Wairale / MADE EASY) if budget allows.

Exam technique: attempt GA first (about 20 min, target 12-15 marks), then 1-markers, then 2-markers. MSQ and NAT have no negative marking, so never leave them blank. Skip MCQs where you can't eliminate at least 2 options (-1/3 or -2/3). Practise with the GATE virtual calculator.
Code tracing is a large part of the paper: practise reading Python snippets (recursion, list/dict mutation, sorting passes, swap counts, tree traversals) on paper, without running them.

Final 2 weeks: no new topics. Re-read formula sheets and mistake logs, re-solve wrong PYQs and mock questions, and do 2 full mocks in the real 2:30-5:30 PM slot to set your body clock (DA has been an afternoon paper).

Admin: complete the application (extended deadline 12 Oct 2026, correction window 14-21 Oct), check the paper-wise schedule (Dec/Jan) and city allotment (4 Jan 2027), and download the admit card as soon as it is released.
